closedDefect.defect: WorkRevalidationPort.readAttempt returned {taskId,state}|null, so the qualifier could only check that a record EXISTED

correction.portShape: { ok: true, taskId, state, creationEventId } | { ok: false, reason }
correction.reuse: src/install.ts constructs the port by calling the SAME exported `admitAttempt` the ordinary V0 Preview uses, so the exact historical ATTEMPT_CREATED event is verified (entity_id === attemptId, project_id === projectId, exactly one creation event, and the record must not contradict its own creation event)
correction.refusalSurfaced: a Work refusal is reported as SOURCE_REFUSED rather than read as 'attempt not found'

properties: exact canonical ATTEMPT_CREATED identity is verified
an unknown or foreign Attempt causes ZERO DSH reads (the adapter admits Work before any association access)
a historical COMPLETED attempt still retains valid historical execution evidence (an old attempt need not remain RUNNING)
the association does not modify Work truth: the gate measured the Attempt left RUNNING with no Promotion
reusedExistingLogic: src/composition/trajectory_v0.ts:admitAttempt (exported for reuse; the P2-C stage did not reimplement Work admission)
